latest_release.name: v1.1.0 — Route ③, doctor.py, macOS/Windows support, English README
latest_release.body:
Since v1.0.0: a new browser-free route, a self-check script, macOS and Windows support, and a rewritten README showcase. Routes are now ①②③④ with no gaps.

## Added

- **Route ③ — scripted pose transfer** (`scripts/run_pose_transfer.py`): change a character's pose from a textureless 3D mannequin render, no browser involved. Dual-image edit + VNCCS PoseStudio LoRA @1.0. Route ④ saves suitable mannequin renders (`doll_*.png`) automatically.
- **`scripts/doctor.py`** — read-only environment self-check: ComfyUI connectivity, base models, LoRAs, VNCCS nodes, pose library and browser backend, each with fix instructions.
- **`scripts/make_custom_pose.py`** — build custom poses from poses already in the library (#4).
- **English README** (`README.en.md`), with a language switcher on both READMEs.
- **macOS (Apple Silicon) support**: documented guidance, plus a `macos-latest` CI job that runs the offline package checks on Apple's runner.
- **Windows compatibility** for `doctor.py` output, the media lock and the pose index (#9).
- Hardware requirements section (issue #5) and an acknowledgements section.

## Changed

- Licensed original code and docs under **Apache-2.0** (third-party assets keep their own terms).
- README showcase rewritten: full-width animated cover card for the NSFW author originals, click-to-expand instead of inline, plus a Route ④ demo GIF at the top.
- Setup guide corrected for the edit LoRA, VNCCS and the pose library (#2).
- `--list-poses` hint, usage text and setup wording polished; dead code dropped.
- Photo/illustration pose references are now called out explicitly as unsupported (the model composites or redraws the reference person) — use a 3D mannequin render instead.

## Fixed

- Result naming for full pose keys (#1).
- Five pose previews replaced; `validate_package.py` now fails on empty preview files.
- Placeholder pose renamed.
- `validate_package.py` also validates `README.en.md` images.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Arekejoker/qwen21-nsfw-pose-skill/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0

# qwen21-nsfw-pose [![Package checks](https://github.com/Arekejoker/qwen21-nsfw-pose-skill/actions/workflows/validate.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/Arekejoker/qwen21-nsfw-pose-skill/actions/workflows/validate.yml) [English](README.en.md) | 中文 **Qwen-Image 2.1 本地 NSFW / 姿势出图完整配方** — 作者级提示词结构 + NSFW LoRA + 136 个 3D 姿势库 + VNCCS 人偶精确姿势控制。 基于 ComfyUI + `qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot` 底模（与 Civitai 作者同款底模），复刻并验证过 Civitai 作者样图（2026-10-12）。 - 适用：Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / OpenClaw（agent 技能）+ 人类手动使用 - 内容：可跟跑的作者案例、强制配方、姿势大胆度阶梯（L0–L3）、完整依赖与安装指南 **演示**（3D 人偶调姿势 → 一键生成 → 成品，Route ④）： --- ## 效果展示 ### 本配方输出：同一海边场景的三级对照（L0 → L1 → L2） | L0 · 全着装，无 LoRA（提示词即全部） | L1 · 湿身泳装 + LoRA@1.0 | L2 · 极低机位 + 湿身蹲姿 + LoRA@1.0 | | --- | --- | --- | | | | | 三张图同场景递进：L0 只有提示词；L1 加 LoRA + 显式皮肤/水珠描写；L2 再加低机位与开合姿态。**LoRA 负责质感，提示词负责信息密度，机位负责大胆度。** ### NSFW 效果（⚠️ 以下图片包含裸露内容）

👇 点击上方卡片展开作者原图（含裸露内容 · 18+，再点收起） **作者原图**（Civitai showcase，本配方复刻的目标）： | 作者 · 淋浴（tawsLoRa） | 作者 · 按摩（tawsLoRa） | 作者 · 自拍（TheseAlpacas） | | --- | --- | --- | | | | |
用 §「快速开始」的命令可复刻淋浴那张（复刻输出已验证与作者原图同场景同构图，见 `downloads/samples/phase5_meta.json` 与本文快速开始一节）。 ### 3D 人偶精确姿势（Route ④，136 姿势库） 默认人物图 `references/src_standing.png`；姿势 = 骨骼旋转 JSON（MakeHuman 网格 + three.js 渲染）， 换姿势且保身份。姿势库来源：HuggingFace 4 个公开仓库（`Totemistyk/General_Poses`、 `Totemistyk/Ballet_PoseStudio`、`MIUProject/VNCCS_PoseLibrary_Main`、 `MIUProject/MySuperPoseRepo`）+ 55 个手工精选，共 **136 个**。 --- ## 快速开始（作者案例跟跑） 前置安装见 [install/setup.md](install/setup.md)。装好后先跑一次自检（只读，不改动任何东西）： ```bash python3 scripts/doctor.py ``` 它逐项检查 ComfyUI 连通性、底模/LoRA、VNCCS 节点、姿势库、浏览器后端，并给出缺失项的修复指引。 全绿后一条命令复刻作者淋浴样图（~5 分钟）： ```bash python3 scripts/qwen_pose_test.py \ --mode t2i --name author_case_shower \ --prompt "$(cat prompts/taws_v13_shower.txt)" \ --seed 80964 \ --steps 50 --cfg 2.5 --sampler er_sde --scheduler beta \ --width 1152 --height 1728 \ --lora "qwen2_1-femaledVaginus-nsfw-v1_3-fine_L22-31.safetensors" \ --lora-strength 1.0 \ --out outputs/author_case/shower.png ``` 对比对象：`downloads/samples/taws_v13_shower_author.jpg`。 完整元数据（提示词/参数/seed/完整工作流）：`downloads/samples/phase5_meta.json`。 ### 硬件要求（参考） 底模为 Qwen-Image 2.1 int8 套件，模型文件合计约 16GB（diffusion 6.8GB / text encoder 8.7GB / VAE 0.6GB），LoRA 各自 ≤608MB。 - **最低**：NVIDIA 12GB 显存 + 32GB 内存——能跑，Comfy
